column3: title card: attached by the dictionary (ERP_FRIENDLY_OPS_LENS.md §18)
column5: F: Manufacturing, part three: the dictionary, not the code. | M: How the Order Receipt and Issue form is attached to the manufacturing order. Three dictionary rows, the way iDempiere does it.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT card.legacy Service-Component=MFGModelFactory, MFGDocFactory, MFGValidator · card.here manifest id org.idempiere.mfg, activation lazy on window 53009, dictionary rows, 3 hot chunks
column5: M: First, what a plugin is. | F: In iDempiere, Libero is an OSGi bundle: a manifest file, three service components for models, documents and the validator, and a 2Pack for the dictionary. | M: Here it is one JavaScript module: a manifest carrying its dictionary rows, and an activate step that registers the same services. It wakes when the manufacturing order window first opens.
F: The Plugins panel lists what the bundle registered. | M: Among them, a form factory for the class V Order Receipt Issue.

M: Now the dictionary itself, logged in as System. The Form window. | F: We find Order Receipt. Its name is Order Receipt and Issue, and its Classname is that same class. | M: In iDempiere that name loads a Java class. Here it finds the form the plugin registered under the same name.

column5: F: Report and Process. | M: A process named Order Receipt and Issue, search key P P Order Receipt Issue. | F: Its Form field points to that form, number fifty-three thousand and seven, and its entity type is the manufacturing one.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT tab.record Manufacturing Order (53027) seq 10 · toolbarButton.grid 1 row Order Receipt & Issue PP_Order_ReceiptIssue seq 10
column5: M: Window, Tab and Field, on the Manufacturing Order window. | F: Its Tab tab holds one record per tab, so we find the header tab by name: Manufacturing Order, on the table PP Order. | M: Under it, Toolbar Button. One row: Order Receipt and Issue, running that process. | F: This is where iDempiere attaches a process to a window, and the twin reads it the same way.

column3: card: 3 rows (AD_Process 1000100, AD_ToolBarButton 1000100, AD_Process_Access role 102) · W-AD-TBB T1 87/87, T2 15/15 (recorded)
column5: F: Three rows: the process, the button, and the right to run it. | M: The plugin ships them in its manifest, and stopping it removes them. | F: The buttons themselves are iDempiere's own mechanism. The twin reads all eighty-seven legacy rows, row for row, and fifteen of fifteen tabs show the same buttons as legacy.

column5: M: As GardenWorld Admin, on a manufacturing order. | F: The new button, Order Receipt and Issue. It opens the form exactly as the menu does.
F: Stop the plugin. | M: The process, the button and the access row are gone. The order window has no button.
